name: Employee, 40,000, church tax 9%
workings: Contributions (employee shares, childless): pension 9.3% × 40,000 = 3,720.00; unemployment 1.3% = 520.00; health (7.3% + 1.45%) × 40,000 = 3,500.000; care 2.4% = 960.00

Special expenses: pension 3,720.00 (employee and employer shares within 30,826, less the employer's); health × 0.96 (sick pay) + care = 4,320.00, above 1,900, so the unemployment contribution isn't deductible
Church tax (9%) replaces the €36 lump sum and depends on the tax: K = 9% × T(30,730.00 − K); fixed point K = 388.232465, taxable income 30,341.767535
